impactLabel: Map Boundary Patch Safe, But Bundle Size Unchanged
productionDecision: Patch 4 safely converted OperationalMap.jsx to dynamic MapLibre loading and the build passed. The largest bundle chunks did not meaningfully shrink, so the next optimization should target route-level lazy loading or the remaining core static map import with caution.

recommendedDecision: Choose Option A first if the goal is safest optimization. Choose Option B only if you are ready to visually recheck the core map route immediately after patching.
